videos.voice: Want more ball time indoors without the sharp floor slap? MING EAGLE silent basketballs use soft foam for quieter play. They are not completely silent, and every floor sounds different. Compare the models and try a sample on your own surface. Explore MING EAGLE at mingeagle.com.

videos.title: The mini hoop needs time to bond
videos.voice: Setting up the mini hoop? Start with a smooth, clean, solid and dry surface. Apply the supplied adhesive pad, press firmly for at least one minute, then wait at least one hour before light play. Check the mount before use. Follow the complete installation guide at mingeagle.com.
shots: 0–4s: Show a suitable surface and wipe it clean; no painted wall.
4–10s: Apply pad and show a “Press: 1 minute minimum” overlay; do not imply that the shortened clip is the full pressing time.
10–16s: Show a “Wait: 1 hour minimum” title between shots.
16–24s: Check the secured hoop and show a light shot; no hanging or forceful dunk.
videos.overlay: Press ≥1 minute • Wait ≥1 hour • Light play only
videos.caption: A good first session starts with the correct setup. Read the surface, pressing and waiting instructions before mounting the mini hoop. #MiniHoop #IndoorPlay #Basketball
